title: From a tag to AsHyAmS
description: StroggForge publishes and the site records. AsHyAmS only ever reads what the site published.

nodes.title: A tag is pushed
nodes.detail: The release is declared in the project's mod.toml.

nodes.title: rustGlobalBuild / libGlobalBuild
nodes.detail: Builds, signs and publishes the archives, or the crate to crates.io.

nodes.title: modGlobalBuild
nodes.detail: Records the release in mod.lock and deploys the site.

nodes.title: The site's manifest
nodes.detail: Lists the release with every artifact's digest. The authority.

nodes.title: AsHyAmS refresh
nodes.detail: Every six hours: downloads only the manifests whose digest in dreamweave.json changed.

nodes.title: AsHyAmS
nodes.detail: The release appears on its project page, in Updates with a typed diff, and in the feed.
